content.text: Resubmitted. The only substantive change was to express the period as "ninety (90) days" so the warranty duration is unambiguous on its face (curing the numeral-matching failure); the operative bargain is unchanged: a 90-day documentation-conformance warranty extended to software, deletion of the Vendor-favourable correction/refund cut-off, with the untimed 19.1 Services warranty and 19.4 repair/replace and refund remedies relied on as already met.
